response.original_title: Nevermore: The Imaginary Life and Mysterious Death of Edgar Allan Poe
response.overview: Catalyst Theatre's gothic musical fantasia, written, composed and directed by Jonathan Christenson, follows Edgar Allan Poe as he struggles with tragedy, addiction, poverty and loss while producing some of the world's most enduring literature. Filmed in 2023 at Calgary's Vertigo Theatre, this 15th-anniversary production reunites the original cast for the first time since 2011.
